item.stem:
Deepa looks at the diagram. Straight lines $EF$ and $GH$ cross at $N$. The marked angle $\angle ENG$ is $58^{\circ}$, and $q$ labels the angle vertically opposite $\angle ENG$.

Which two claims are correct?

One or more options may be correct.

options.C: Vertically opposite angles at the same crossing are equal.
options.D: Adjacent angles on a straight line are equal.
